title: feat(mcp): the open draft door saves and discards drafts, and each save answers with its publish verdict
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Part of #34766
Stacked on #35059 — lands only after #35059 merges

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:开放 MCP 草稿门新增 `save_metadata_draft`、`delete_metadata_draft` 两个写工具;`list_drafts` 每条草稿附带发布裁决。metadata-protocol 的 `draftPublishJudgement` 改为公开方法,可直接读已存草稿。写入与裁决同 `/meta` 一样先过类型级读写准入。
- 为什么改:AI 通过 OAuth 写元数据时只落草稿,同一次回复里就能看到"发布会被拒在哪条规则、哪个路径、下一步怎么做",由人在 Studio 审核发布。
- 风险与回滚:新增写面但只写草稿,无发布工具、无 `force`;受 `metadata:write` + `manage_metadata` 双重门禁、`/meta` 类型级准入和 walled 租户拒写约束。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`(save/delete 分支、`typeAdmission`、list_drafts 的逐条裁决)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`(无 body 时读已存草稿)、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`(initialize 文案)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`,预期 36/36 通过,其中 done-when 用例返回 `flow-trigger-unroutable` 及其路径与 hint。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(须等 #35059 先合并)。

## What changes

- **D2, the public verdict.** `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.draftPublishJudgement` is now public. The facade line stays at its ceiling: the change is in place, with a delta of 0 lines. With no `body`, the gate reads the stored draft at `type`/`name`/`packageId` (and `member` for a bundled type), and an absent draft answers `404 NO_DRAFT`. It is the same judgement the draft read and the publish gate run; there is no second routine.
- **`save_metadata_draft({ type, name, item, package, ifMatch? })`** calls `saveMetaItem` with `mode: 'draft'`, `surface: 'mcp'` and `client.id` set to the token's OAuth client, plus `writeFace: 'meta-dispatch'`; `ifMatch` maps to `parentVersion`. The reply holds three parts:
  - `saved`: type, name, package, state and version.
  - `verdict`: `publishable`, plus `refusals` and `advisories`, each with rule, path, message, hint and severity.
  - `review`: the Studio routes `/studio/PKG/interfaces?changes=review` and `/studio/PKG/metadata/TYPE/NAME?review=1`.
  - If the judgement throws, the reply says `verdict: null` plus `verdictError`. The draft stays saved and the save is not reported as refused.
- **D4.** A save with no `package` is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, naming the writable packages (capped at 20). `package` is deliberately left out of the JSON schema's `required` list: the SDK enforces `required`, so listing it there would make this named refusal unreachable.
- **`delete_metadata_draft({ type, name, package? })`** calls `deleteMetaItem` with `state: 'draft'`.
- **`list_drafts`.** Each draft carries its `verdict`, gated per item with PR-a's item read gate. A draft the human may not read gets `verdict: null` plus `verdictWithheld`, so no finding derived from its body leaks. The list itself stays ungated, matching `/meta/_drafts`, and state `draft` keeps the overlaid `getMetaItems` read.
- **Gates.** The same D1 gate covers every tool. Both writes then ask the `/meta` type-level write admission (`metaTypeWriteRefusal`, the save as `PUT`, the discard as `DELETE`) with the human as the caller, and then `walledCatalogWriteVerdict` with the envelope's tenancy posture, before anything is written: a metadata type the caller may not write is refused 403, a walled tenant is refused 403, and a platform admin is admitted. A failed posture read answers 503 and nothing is written. The authoring admission alone does not cover a type whose own write door requires more.
- **Verdicts and the type-level read admission.** A verdict is a read of the stored draft's body, so the save's verdict and each listed draft's verdict are told only where `metaTypeReadRefusal` admits the human; elsewhere the reply carries `verdict: null` and `verdictWithheld`. The reads inherit PR-a's rule (merged in): both read tools ask the same admission before any read.
- **Type fold.** `type` is folded to its canonical singular before any gate, verdict, refusal or write, through PR-a's one module helper `canonicalTypeOf`. This branch's local copy is gone; `list_drafts`' per-draft fold goes through the same helper.
- **`initialize`.** When the authoring tools are listed, the open server's default instructions add one paragraph: these tools save drafts only, and a person publishes them in Studio. The paragraph is absent when the tools are not served.
- **Refusals carry their findings.** A coded protocol refusal keeps its code, status and message and now also relays the thrown `issues[]`: the save states the `meta-dispatch` face, which trims a spec-validation refusal's message to a headline because that face declares a structured channel, so the findings travel beside it.
- **Registry-question producers.** The save is recorded in `REGISTRY_QUESTION_PRODUCERS` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts`), by face: `meta-dispatch` and always `mode: 'draft'`, so the body-only question. The face set's note now says `meta-dispatch` is stated at a second door. The runtime repo tier's producer census (`metadata-registry-question-producers.test.ts`) reads that ledger.
- **`check:system-context-census`.** `openWriter` reads the envelope's `isSystem` for the walled verdict, so row 55b of `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` now lists the draft save and discard among its doors and names `openWriter`; the generated site register was rewritten by `--write`.
- **`check:durability-log-level`.** The tool switch's outer catch guards `saveMetaItem` and returns `refusalFromThrown` on its only path, an `isError` tool result carrying the error envelope. That hands the failure to the caller, so the site is declared in `FAILURE_PROPAGATION_SITES` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts::execute`, callee `refusalFromThrown`, `via: 'return'`), the remedy the gate's own text and AGENTS.md name for this shape; no log was added.

## Tests

At `7cbb4252a9`:

- Runtime `src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`: 36/36. This includes the done-when end-to-end test on the app-crm shape, run against a real SqlDriver (better-sqlite3) store with `crm_opportunity`:
  - An unnamed save is refused 400, naming the authored package.
  - The save answers `flow-trigger-unroutable` with its path and hint.
  - `list_drafts` lists the draft with the same verdict.
  - The delete empties the list.
- Runtime repo tier `src/metadata-registry-question-producers.test.ts`: 3/3 (it was red on `a94722fca2` in `Test Core (3/10)`: the save was an unrecorded producer).
- metadata-protocol `protocol.invalid-metadata-422-face-inventory.test.ts` and `protocol.destructive-409-face-inventory.test.ts`: 60/60.
- New pins:
  - On the real protocol, a save the schema refuses answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with its structured findings beside the headline, and writes nothing.
  - A type the caller may not write is refused on the save and the discard before anything is written; a holder of the type's capability writes it.
  - A save of a type the caller may not read lands, and its verdict is withheld rather than read.
  - `list_drafts` withholds the verdict of a draft whose type the caller may not read, without reading its body.
  - On the real protocol, an inherited member's name as `type` (`constructor`, `toString`), which the fold keeps as sent, is refused on save and discard and leaves no draft.
- metadata-protocol `protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` and `sys-metadata-repository.draft-drain.test.ts` (it reads the durability script): 72/72.
- mcp full suite: 71 files, 1269/1269.
- Typecheck exits 0 for runtime and metadata-protocol at `7cbb4252a9`, and for mcp at `1294fe181c` (no mcp file moved since).

<details><summary>Ablations, at 1294fe181c</summary>

Each ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock. The suite imports the module relatively from `src/`, so no `dist/` is on the subject's path. Every restore read blob == HEAD `04e3fe15e4fc` with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- (a) Dropping `verdict` from the save reply: 2 failed / 33 passed (the save-shape pin and the done-when pin).
- (b) Dropping the package requirement: 2 failed / 33 passed (the D4 pin and the done-when pin).
- (c) Dropping the type-level write admission: 1 failed / 34 passed (the write-admission pin).
- (d) Dropping the type-level read admission: 3 failed / 32 passed (PR-a's read pin, the save-verdict pin and the `list_drafts` pin).
- (e) At `7cbb4252a9`, dropping the relayed `issues`: 1 failed / 35 passed (the structured-findings pin), restored blob == HEAD `647fb95516d8`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **An inherited member's name as `type`.** `save_metadata_draft` and `delete_metadata_draft` with `type: "constructor"` write nothing, but the protocol answers them as faults, not as an unknown type: the save fails inside the protocol with an error that names the metadata store as unreadable, and the discard with a TypeError in the spelling module's own fold. The door keeps the agent's string, so this is the protocol's fold (`canonicalMetaUrlType` reading a plain object), the shape PR-a recorded. The pin above asserts the refusal and the absent draft, and does not pin the status.
- #34979 shares `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` and merges cleanly; the seat accepted it as a clean neighbour.
- Optional, not folded (L1-c N2 on #35059): for type `object`, `/meta`'s `listMetaItems` reads `getMetaItemsForExecution` while the door reads `getMetaItems`. The verdict is the same and only the cost differs; these tools do not add that member.
- `clientSpecVersion` is deliberately not accepted. It is #34774's contract, and accepting it here would make it an inert parameter.

## Verification

- Merged: PR-a's heads `b7838f512f`, `c50358b59c` and `c2fa38c8b4`, and `origin/main` at `0e46840fca`, then at `aef42cba4e` (through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`; no conflict). The one main conflict, `packages/mcp/src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`, was two describes added at the same place; both are kept.
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: merges cleanly with `origin/main` (6f2bd4f84c), #35059, #35122 and #34817.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no mandate derived from the paths. `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 2184 changed lines (+2170 / -14), under 3000.
- At `7cbb4252a9`: `check:durability-log-level`, `check:system-context-census` and `check:nul-bytes` exit 0. Local gate families at `a94722fca2`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 125 families (17 paths vs merge base `0e46840fc`); all 125 ran, each exit captured before any pipe, all 125 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` included. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "125 derived, 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: 0 anchors lost. Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs.
